title: Valid Parentheses
inputFormat: Line 1: the string s, containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']'.
outputFormat: Print `true` if s is a valid bracket sequence, otherwise `false`.
constraints:
1 <= |s| <= 10^4
s consists only of the characters '()[]{}'.

examples.explanation: Every bracket is closed by the same type in the correct order.
'(' is closed by ']', so the ordering is invalid.
